title: Honey Cake for the Guests
story: On Sunday the family expected guests from their grandmother's village. Noor wanted to bake the honey cake that the village served at visits. Her uncle read the old card while Noor set out flour, eggs, and honey. They warmed the honey so it would mix more easily. Noor stirred slowly, and her uncle checked the oven. The cake rose, and the kitchen smelled sweet. Noor made tea and put small plates on the table. When the guests arrived, she offered the first slice to her grandmother's friend. The friend smiled and said the taste was familiar. People asked about the honey, and Noor explained each step. She did not rush, because the story of the cake mattered too. Later she copied the card in clear writing and stored it in a tin. She hoped to bake the same cake again next spring.
